acceptanceConclusion.basis: Observed local journeys, inspected real-content captures, directly authored copy/source ledger, targeted regressions and full required gates; no recruited usability or production certification.

reproduction.method: Independent actual browser walkthrough of PP/PSOE/Sumar at af8ea00, plus inspection of existing application captures.

implemented: One semantic article per proposal, with full-width proposition and two/three equal programme columns; narrow screens read each formation exactly once. Exact names, stances and complete authored summaries remain visible.

Native on-demand search/filter tools at every width. Search all 80 proposals in the existing selection; show Todos los temas during search; clearing restores topic/page. Query/filter empty state names both constraints and offers Quitar filtro.

Mostrar citas reveals all exact original quotations for the proposal together, keeping interpretation and conditions visible. Expanded quotation state survives source return, topic/filter rendering and cancelled selection replacement.

Full source reader begins with compact proposition, formation, edition, original quote and locator; full context, provenance and interpretation follow separately. Contextual Back and labelled close/Escape retain source opener/scroll/query.
Native formation grid uses available width and shares SSR/hydrated markup rules. Responsive container queries also reflow columns for enlarged text.

iterations.correction: Use a labelled close symbol and remove inherited button padding; preserve contextual Back and native button focus.

iterations.correction: Keep expanded proposal IDs in memory and restore during render; keyboard/return regression passes.

iterations.correction: Name search plus filter, and remove only the filter while retaining query; regression passes.

independentReview.sourceReturn: Exact opener/scroll and inline-citation expansion retained. Two cancellation/empty-state defects were reproduced and then corrected with targeted tests.

comparison.changed: Native selection/search/filter and live exact result count; Mostrar/Ocultar citas exposes its expanded state.
comparison.return: Source Back/Escape restores query, scroll, opener and visible quotations; cancelled replacement retains previous programmes and open quotations.

source.return: Contextual Back and close/Escape retain existing nested reader behavior and semantic opener.
